review_boundary.location_basis: Repository locations retained from the completed audit refer to the reviewed head/tree, before current text integration; line numbers are not promised to remain current.

origin.artifact_hash_scope: Identity of the completed audit HTML bytes only; not a hash of original browser DOM, an authenticated source archive or proof that a displayed permanent revision was reopened.
origin.transfer: All 27 wiki_observations and all 8 publisher_sources are copied literally from the completed reconciled audit register.

provenance.original_limit: Manually transcribed observation register and reconciled review records; not a full raw DOM export. Original specialist reports remain temporary working notes; their final decisions are fully represented here.
provenance.revision_limit: Displayed permanent links identify the revisions reported by the inspected article pages. Each oldid URL was not independently reopened; page modification dates are distinct from observation windows and do not date each individual rule.
provenance.cache_limit: Recorded pages showed logged-out cache ages of 4 to 14 hours. No cache match was recorded for Overwhelming Critical; a missing cache value is not zero.
provenance.scope_limit: The Imbue_Dice request redirected to Imbue and its collapsed imbue table was not expanded. The crafting review covered the needed visible legendary rows, not omitted tail content.
provenance.publisher_limit: The audit records that these official pages were opened, but its embedded register supplies no per-page capture timestamps or raw text; none are invented here. Earlier updates are historical where later updates supersede them.
provenance.repository_limit: Repository records establish selected choices, prior evidence boundaries or implementation behavior. They do not independently prove mechanics and receive no new external observation timestamp.
provenance.license_limit: Attribution preserves the observed Wiki license notice; it does not supply missing source observations or authenticate the transcriptions.
